items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: I didn't meet him but I was in Los Angeles at the time.

ctx.x: Sure. Art Tatum. I didn't meet him but I was in Los Angeles at the time. And I went to the theater, you know like you go in, and I caught the last part of the movie. I said, well I want to see how this thing started. And then before this thing started the lights came on the stage and all the man said, ladies gentlemen, Art Tatum, that's all he said. And that man sat up there and he played as much piano for the time he was up there man, I said, I got a piano ringing in my ears for a-
If you want to, and you know you're never going to be as good as that.
